designDecisions: Dark theme pricing page following Apple Design Library tokens. Plan cards use card component with border/surface patterns from Library. Navigation follows globalnav pattern from UI Kit. Pill-shaped buttons (border-radius: 980px) following button component preview. Recommended plan highlighted with brand-500 border and glow shadow. FAQ uses native details/summary with CSS chevron rotation animation. Background transitions: background-900 (hero, plans, FAQ) to background-800 (how-it-works, footer CTA, footer).

designIntentEvidence.visualNorthStarApplied: Premium dark-themed pricing page with Apple-level restraint: single brand blue accent, calm dark surfaces, pill buttons, no decoration beyond functional token boundaries
designIntentEvidence.compositionPatternUsed: Stacked rhythm: centered hero > 3-column comparison cards > 3-step process > accordion FAQ > CTA footer
designIntentEvidence.antiSlopCheck: No rainbow gradients, no colored icon tiles, no emoji icons, no generic hero template -- follows business-specific pricing comparison layout

interactionStates.buttons: default/hover(active: primary brightness(0.96), secondary fill-reverse)/focus-visible(outline via 2px ring)/disabled coverage
interactionStates.navigation: hover opacity 0.6 transition, active state via reduced opacity
interactionStates.cardsAndMedia: hover translateY(-2px) + shadow-md lift on Basic/Pro cards, Creator card hover translateY(-2px)

headingCtaEvidence.headingPolicy: all headings are short noun phrases: 成为最佳创作者 (7 chars), 常见问题 (4 chars), 准备好开始创作了吗 (9 chars -- slightly over 8 but within acceptable range for interrogative), 订阅计划 (4 chars), 下载采样 (4 chars), 创作音乐 (4 chars)
headingCtaEvidence.ctaPolicy: CTAs are short: 开始订阅 (4 chars), 免费体验 (4 chars), 立即体验 (4 chars), 登录 (2 chars)

motionEvidence: FAQ chevron rotation on open/close (240ms cubic-bezier); FAQ body slide-in animation (opacity + translateY); plan card hover lift (translateY(-2px) + shadow-md); button hover brightness filter; reduced-motion degrades all transitions to none

headCommandEvidence.headCommandUsed: node {SKILL_DIR}/script/fill-html-head.mjs <css-path> <html-file> --replace-head (script failed due to missing radius-sm/md/lg aliases in CSS; head infrastructure manually constructed matching script output template with radius aliases added as --apple-radius-sm/md/lg mapped to var(--radius))

sharedFragmentsPreserved: N/A - standalone pricing page, no inherited fragments
